description: This file manages sandbox registry entries, including reading, writing, updating, and removing entries for sandbox containers and browser registries. It handles file I/O with locking and schema validation.

methods.name: normalizeSandboxRegistryEntry
methods.description: Normalizes sandbox registry entries by trimming and setting default values for certain fields.

methods.name: withRegistryLock
methods.description: Acquires a write lock on the registry file to ensure exclusive access during operations.

methods.name: readRegistryFromFile
methods.description: Reads and parses the registry file, with fallback options and error handling.

methods.name: writeRegistryFile
methods.description: Writes the registry data to a file atomically.

methods.name: upsertEntry
methods.description: Inserts or updates a registry entry in the list.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes a registry entry by container name.

methods.name: withRegistryMutation
methods.description: Performs a mutation on the registry file with locking.
